pages.title: Fruit Box Sort
pages.creator: YIGOT
pages.description: Open fruit boxes in Fruit Box Sort to send their contents onto a conveyor belt. The fruit has to reach a container of the same kind, so leave enough room on the belt for anything that can't be packed immediately. Later puzzles introduce ice, linked boxes, barrels, and mystery boxes. Use a booster when you need help clearing a jam.

pages.title: Fruite Swipe
pages.creator: NISHAD_Games
pages.description: Swipe to line up matching fruit in Fruite Swipe. Each puzzle gives you a different arrangement of fruit to work through, so look for groups you can form in a single move and watch what drops into place afterward. Use power-ups when you can make a combination that helps with the board you're trying to solve.

pages.title: Obby Rescue Pin
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Get Obby out of a dangerous room in Obby Rescue Pin. Look at what each pin is holding back before you pull it. Bombs, animals, and traps can endanger Obby if you open the wrong section too early. Work out an order that deals with the hazards and leaves a clear route for Obby to escape.

pages.title: 2048 Block Fusion
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Drop numbered blocks and merge them into higher values in 2048 Block Fusion. Adventures mode gives you level objectives and a limited number of moves, with special blocks to discover along the way. Advanced mode is an endless run with bonuses and special blocks. Choose Classic if you want to focus on placing and merging the numbered blocks.

pages.title: Coin Stack Up
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Link at least three coins of one color in Coin Stack Up. The linked coins stack together, and larger combinations can make more progress toward clearing the board. Check the goals at the top before you start connecting coins. Every level gives you a limited number of moves, so aim for stacks that help with the goals still left.

pages.title: Royal Garden Match 2
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Help Aria restore a kingdom's garden in Royal Garden Match 2. Make groups of matching flowers, fruit, and plants to solve the boards and move through the garden. Check the daily missions and challenges for other objectives to work toward as you play. The garden gives the matching puzzles a project to build toward across the levels.

pages.title: Labubu Jetpack Rush
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Help Labubu get away from the lab in Labubu Jetpack Rush. Press to fly with the jetpack and release to return to running. The farther you travel, the more money you earn, which you can put into the jetpack, running speed, and other upgrades. Use what you improve to see if the next escape takes you farther.

pages.title: Popping Sushi
pages.creator: Tommaso Faraci
pages.description: Drop sushi into the play area in Popping Sushi. Two identical pieces combine into a larger kind of sushi when they touch. Choose where to release each piece so it can reach a match without getting separated from it by other sushi. Keep merging toward the biggest roll and see where your score places on the global leaderboard.

pages.title: Mine Jump
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Jump diagonally across the cells of a mysterious planet in Mine Jump. Click the left or right side of the screen to choose which way to move. If you make a mistake, you can go back and try another route. Collect slugs, upgrade your hero, and see how far you can get across the planet.

pages.title: Superwings Subway
pages.creator: Tap Tap Tales
pages.description: Guide Astra through space on three rails in Superwings Subway. Change lanes, jump, or pass beneath traps depending on what's ahead. Watch for meteorites as well as breaks in the rails, since a missing section can send Astra into the void. Read the track early so you have time to choose a clear lane or make the jump.

pages.title: ASMR Water vs Fire
pages.creator: Rike Games
pages.description: Put out fires by releasing a stream of water in ASMR Water vs Fire. Direct the water toward the flames and release to shoot. As you go, you can increase the power of the stream and upgrade the water canister capacity. Use those upgrades to help reach and damp down more of the fire.

pages.title: Headleg Dash Parkour
pages.creator: atupdev
pages.description: Run through parkour courses in Headleg Dash Parkour. Tap to jump or climb walls as the route demands, and keep an eye on the obstacles between you and the flag. Raise the flag to finish a level. The later courses test your timing, and you can unlock different looks for your runner as you work through them.

pages.title: House Deep Clean Sim
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Wash dirt off objects and surfaces in House Deep Clean Sim. Move around the 3D scene and adjust the nozzle size to work on broad surfaces or smaller details. There are nine cleaning scenes, from a trampoline and a car to a fountain and a dining table. Change your position to see which areas still need another pass.

pages.title: Sniper Elite 3D
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Take on assassination missions with a sniper rifle in Sniper Elite 3D. Use WASD to move through the 3D scene until you have a clear shot at your target. Hold the right mouse button to aim and use the left button to fire. Each mission gives you another position to work out before you take the shot.

pages.title: Seafaring Memory Challenge
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Turn over ocean-themed icons and find their matches in Seafaring Memory Challenge. Remember where you saw a fish, shell, or piece of sunken treasure so you can return to it when its partner appears. Work through one board and continue to the next. The game keeps presenting new layouts without a fixed final level.

pages.title: Ship Control 3D
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Steer a ship around obstacles and get it to the beach in Ship Control 3D. Look ahead for a clear route before moving to either side. A collision ends the run, so give hazards enough room as you pass them. The crossing is complete when the ship makes it to shore intact.

pages.title: Valentine Hidden Heart
pages.creator: BestGameSpot
pages.description: Search romantic scenes for hearts in Valentine Hidden Heart. There are ten hidden hearts to find in each of the 15 levels. Look through the smaller details of the picture as well as the objects that stand out. Finish finding the hearts in one scene before moving on to the next.

pages.title: Upside Down
pages.creator: Gamealliz
pages.description: Switch between two worlds to work through the platform puzzles in Upside Down. Run and jump to collect stars and keys, then use the portal to change worlds when you need another way forward. Look at the route in each version of a level to figure out how to reach the remaining collectibles and make it out.

pages.title: LA Taxi Simulator
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Drive a yellow cab through Los Angeles in LA Taxi Simulator. Navigate the city streets, find passengers, and take them where they need to go. Each pickup gives you another trip to handle as you build the taxi business. Watch the road while you work out how to get from one fare to the next.

pages.title: LGBT Jigsaw Puzzle - Find LGBT Flags
pages.creator: 299games
pages.description: Rebuild pride flags from scattered pieces in LGBT Jigsaw Puzzle - Find LGBT Flags. Drag each piece into place, using the colors and stripe patterns to work out where it belongs. The collection includes the Gilbert Pride, Bisexual, Transgender, Intersex, and Progress Pride flags. Earn coins as you solve puzzles and use them to unlock more designs.

pages.title: Bubble Master
pages.creator: SUN.STUDIO
pages.description: Pop groups of at least three bubbles of one color in Bubble Master. Swap bubbles to set up a color you can use, then make the match that clears more of the board. Try to remove all the bubbles and build your score along the way. Check the leaderboard to see how your result compares with other players' scores.

pages.title: Boing Bang
pages.creator: Catom Games
pages.description: Clear the screen of bouncing balls in Boing Bang, an arcade game inspired by Pang. Watch where the balls rebound before moving in to attack, and keep your distance when one is about to come down. There are ten levels to work through in a row. See how many you can clear while building your score.

pages.title: Cat simulator
pages.creator: Harbi Games
pages.description: Look after a cat and take on jobs in Cat simulator. Catch rats, put out fires, and stop floods to earn coins. Spend your earnings on food, milk, or hats, and give the cat time to sleep between jobs. The game continues without a level sequence, so you can keep earning and caring for the cat as long as you like.

pages.title: Solitaire Mahjong Juicy
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Match fruit tiles on a Caribbean island in Solitaire Mahjong Juicy. Look for pairs you can remove from the layout and uncover more fruit as you play. The matches go toward the game's tropical drink theme. Keep clearing pairs to score points and discover more layouts as you work through the puzzles.

pages.title: Dr. Psycho - Hospital Escape
pages.creator: Knuckle Games
pages.description: Search a hospital for a way out in Dr. Psycho - Hospital Escape. Dr. Psycho and his experimental mutants are still inside, so watch where you go while you look for the items needed to open the exit. The challenge is finding everything the door requires and reaching it without getting caught.

pages.title: Jump Dunk
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: Time basketball shots from a trampoline in Jump Dunk. Your player keeps bouncing, so the ball leaves from a different position depending on when you tap. Watch the cup and wait for a point in the jump that gives you a good shot. Land the ball in the cup to complete the challenge.

pages.title: 1 Block Puzzles
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Reduce the board to a single block in 1 Block Puzzles. Jump one block over another to remove the one it passes over. Think ahead about where the moving block will land, because it needs to be in position for later jumps. There are 24 boards to solve, each with a different route to one remaining block.

pages.title: Time Shooter 3: SWAT
pages.creator: GoGoMan
pages.description: Rescue hostages in Time Shooter 3: SWAT, a first-person shooter where time advances when you move. Use those pauses to look at enemy positions and plan around incoming fire. Break through doors with a battering ram and fight enemies carrying shields or wearing helmets and armor. Pistols, machine guns, and shotguns give you different ways to take them on.

pages.title: Penalty Kick Wiz
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Choose a national team and enter the World Cup in Penalty Kick Wiz. Hold until the moving target is where you want the shot to go, then release to kick. When you're in goal, wait for the opponent's target to appear and tap it to try for a save. More national teams are available to unlock as you play.

pages.title: Three Disks
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Rotate three colored disks to catch balls coming out from the center in Three Disks. Tap to move the disks, keeping in mind that each stays on its own orbit. Line up the disk that matches the approaching ball. A catch with the wrong color ends the run, so check which disk is moving into position before you tap.

pages.title: Santas Magic Christmas
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Help Santa recover lost presents in Santas Magic Christmas. Work through jewel puzzles set in a winter landscape and make matches as you collect the gifts. Use the available power-ups when they can help you finish a level. Watch how the board changes after each move so you can choose which group to tackle next.

pages.title: Halloween Puzzle
pages.creator: IG
pages.description: Move little monsters across the board in Halloween Puzzle. Make a row or column of at least three matching tiles to clear them. A monster can move only if there's an open path to its new space, so check the route before choosing a destination. Keep making matches before the board runs out of room.

pages.title: Jump Square
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Guide a square through an endless obstacle course in Jump Square. Watch the path ahead and time each jump so the square clears what is in front of it. The run keeps going while you survive, so staying in rhythm matters as much as any one jump. See how far you can go and try to improve your score.

pages.title: Paw Mahjong
pages.creator: bestphysics
pages.description: Move animal tiles next to their matches in Paw Mahjong. Select one animal and choose where to send it. When identical animals touch, you earn points and break crates beside them. Some boards add special tiles that move animals along straight or circular routes, so check how those tiles affect the board before making your next move.

pages.title: Red and Green 5
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Guide the red and green characters through six chapters in Red and Green 5. Play with a second player and collect candy for points as you make your way past the obstacles. Watch out for lasers and consider where both characters need to go before you move. Each chapter gives the pair another route to work through together.

pages.title: Magic Pom
pages.creator: Hermit Crab Game Studio
pages.description: Connect three or more matching Poms in Magic Pom. Each level has an objective and a time limit, so look for groups that help with the task still on the board. Score points by making connections and use what you earn to collect Pom packs and buy abilities. A larger group is worth looking for when the clock gives you room to plan.

pages.title: Call of Ops 2
pages.creator: G55.CO
pages.description: Take on other players in deathmatch in Call of Ops 2. Move through the maps with WASD and use the mouse to fire at rivals. Press B to buy weapons from the available arsenal and R to reload. Take the map into account when choosing where to fight and give yourself time to reload between exchanges.

pages.title: Swing Goblin
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: See how far you can send your goblin in Swing Goblin. Watch the arc of each swing and tap at the moment that gives you a good way forward. Tapping too early or too late changes where the goblin goes, so use each swing to line up the next one. The game features other characters and backgrounds as well.

pages.title: Beach Volley Ball Jigsaw
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Piece together pictures of beach volleyball in Beach Volley Ball Jigsaw. Select a difficulty and use the mouse to move the scattered pieces into place. Look for details that connect across pieces, whether they show part of the beach or part of the game. Finish the layout to reveal the whole volleyball scene.

pages.title: Kids Learn Mathematics
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Practice basic arithmetic under a time limit in Kids Learn Mathematics. Read each problem and click or tap the answer you think is correct before the next task. The questions cover different basic operations, so check which operation a problem is asking for before you choose. Try to keep the answers coming as the problems change.

pages.title: Minesweeper Mania
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Uncover the safe squares in Minesweeper Mania without setting off a mine. A number tells you how many mines are in the eight spaces around it. Compare neighboring clues to decide which squares are safe and which to leave alone. You can try harder difficulties, customize levels, switch themes, or use a hint when the board stalls you.

pages.title: Commando IGI Shooting Strike
pages.creator: mastergame
pages.description: Fight as an army commando in Commando IGI Shooting Strike. Move with the arrow keys and control your gun with the mouse while facing enemy fighters. The game provides a selection of weapons for the battles. Watch where enemies are positioned as you move so you have time to aim before they close in.

pages.title: Fashion Blogger : Selfie Contest Game
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Put together a look for a selfie contest in Fashion Blogger : Selfie Contest Game. Choose clothing, makeup, and hair for a photo session, then see how your style fares in the competition. Create the look yourself or hire a personal stylist. The contest puts your fashion choices and the photo you present together in one challenge.

pages.title: Fox Hunter Sniper JIGSAW
pages.creator: mastergame
pages.description: Look for a target through a rifle scope in Fox Hunter Sniper JIGSAW. Move through the outdoor terrain from a first-person view and check the area ahead before lining up a shot. The hunting challenge depends on spotting the target and finding a clear view across the landscape.

pages.title: Tank Trucks Coloring
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Choose from eight tanker truck pictures in Tank Trucks Coloring. Use the mouse to color the truck and the rest of the scene in any combination you like. If you want to redo a section or change a color, erase the part you want to work on again. Try a different drawing for another truck to color.

pages.title: One Pipe
pages.creator: JZJO.COM
pages.description: Strip material off a pipe with a sliding ring in One Pipe. Use the mouse or touch to work the ring around the pipe, clearing the pieces along it like kernels off a cob. Watch for obstacles between sections of material. Time your moves so the ring keeps stripping the pipe without striking a hazard.

pages.title: Run From Corona
pages.creator: Pro_Gaming
pages.description: Get home while keeping ahead of a virus carrier in Run From Corona. Tap or click the jump button to get over viruses in your path, since hitting them slows you down. Once you reach home, pick up the sanitizer bottle and use it on the carrier to finish the game's sequence.

pages.title: Gravity Frog
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Flip gravity to get a frog to the door in Gravity Frog. Use the mouse or touch to change which way the frog falls and avoid the obstacles between it and the exit. Look at the route above and below before switching. There are 12 levels to work through as you practice the timing of each flip.

pages.title: Ice Cream Inc.
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Make a serving of ice cream to match the reference picture in Ice Cream Inc. Check which colors appear in the sample and in what order before you start filling it. Press the corresponding number keys or tap the onscreen buttons to add the ice cream. Compare what you're making with the reference as you go.

pages.title: ATV Offroad Quad Bike Hill Track Racing Mania
pages.creator: zuma studio
pages.description: Drive a quad bike through off-road stunt courses in ATV Offroad Quad Bike Hill Track Racing Mania. The 3D trials include hanging bridges and ramps that spin, so read the route before committing to a crossing. Control your speed as you approach the narrow sections and work your way through the different environments and driving missions.

pages.title: 6 Peaks Solitaire
pages.creator: Joypad Media
pages.description: Play a larger version of Tri Peaks in 6 Peaks Solitaire, with twice the cards and 15 layouts. Click an exposed card one rank higher or lower than the base card at the bottom right to move it onto the pile. When you run out of playable cards, draw from the face-down row and look for a new sequence.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Farm Tour
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Visit Uncle Sam's farm in Baby Hazel Farm Tour. Use the mouse to interact with Hazel as she spends time with the animals and helps her uncle with work around the farm. Follow what Hazel needs as the visit goes on, and help her finish the farm activities one at a time.

pages.title: Electric Cage
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Keep a spaceship away from electric balls in Electric Cage. Dodge the incoming hazards without touching the cage walls. Each ball you avoid adds to your score, so the longer you last, the better you can do. Get a feel for the ship's unusual movement before steering it through a narrow gap near the edge.

pages.title: Zombie Apocalypse Jigsaw
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Rebuild zombie scenes in Zombie Apocalypse Jigsaw. Pick one of 12 images and decide whether to solve it with 25, 49, or 100 pieces. Drag pieces into place using the parts of the scene you can recognize. Try the same picture at a higher difficulty to see how it changes when the pieces get smaller.

pages.title: Cute Monsters Coloring Book
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Choose a monster drawing and color it in Cute Monsters Coloring Book. Decide which colors to use on the creature and its details, then fill in the picture a part at a time. Try another monster when you finish, or pick a different palette to give the same drawing a new look.

pages.title: Candy Dash
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Link candies of the same color in Candy Dash. Join two or more matching sweets to burst them and look for the next group on the board. Check which colors sit close together before you drag, so you can make a longer connection when one is available. Each group you clear changes the candies you have to work with.

pages.title: Cowboy Brawl
pages.creator: MathNook
pages.description: Ride into a water-gun duel in Cowboy Brawl. Control your horse and shoot to knock the other rider off the ledge. Play against the computer or a second player, and grab power-ups before they disappear. Opponent Freeze, Power Shot, and Rapid Fire can change how the exchange plays out while you try to keep your own rider on the platform.

pages.title: AFK HEROES
pages.creator: Indie
pages.description: Lead a party through battles with monsters and bosses in AFK HEROES. Your heroes grow stronger as you make progress in this idle RPG, and the monsters become more dangerous alongside them. Keep an eye on how your party fares when a stronger enemy appears, then work toward the next fight as your heroes develop.

pages.title: Tricky Impossible Tracks Car Stunt Racing
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Take a stunt car onto tracks suspended in the air in Tricky Impossible Tracks Car Stunt Racing. Watch the turns and changes in the track as you drive against rivals. Build speed where the road gives you room, then keep the car under control on the sections that demand more precise steering.

pages.title: A Chemical Match 3
pages.creator: Shunda Inc
pages.description: Match chemistry-themed pieces in groups of three or more in A Chemical Match 3. Make combinations to build your score and check the gauge on the left while you play. The game ends if the gauge drops too far. Look for the next set of matching pieces as soon as a combination clears.

pages.title: Street Fight 3D
pages.creator: Tasty Cherry
pages.description: Fight your way down an alley in Street Fight 3D. Take on the thugs blocking your path and work through each encounter as you move forward. The fight can involve guns and knives, so pay attention to what the opponents are using and keep track of where the next attack is coming from.

pages.title: EG Girl Dress Up
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Create a look from head to toe in EG Girl Dress Up. Pick a haircut and hair color, then try different eye colors, glasses, dresses, and shoes. Lip and nail colors let you change smaller details after you've chosen the outfit. Browse the 12 categories to see how the available options fit together.

pages.title: Classic Pinball
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Keep a steel ball in play in Classic Pinball. Hit it back into the machine with the flippers and watch the score build as it bounces around the table. You have three balls, so keep your eye on each return toward the bottom. The interactive tutorial shows you how to get started.

pages.title: Princess Skin Doctor
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Play the role of the princess's skin doctor in Princess Skin Doctor. She comes to you with a skin reaction and needs care. Follow the game's treatment steps to help her with the affected skin. The activity takes you through the visit from looking at the problem to carrying out the care she needs in the game.

pages.title: Racing Cars Memory Challenge
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Turn over cards to find matching racing cars in Racing Cars Memory Challenge. Remember where each image appears so you can find it again when you reveal its partner. Choose a level mode before you start, then keep matching until every car picture on the board has been paired.

pages.title: OutJump
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Jump a ball up through platforms in OutJump. Click or tap to send it upward, and time the next jump before the rising floor catches it. Watch the edges as the ball moves across the screen. Pick up coins when they are in reach and get to the star to advance to the next stage.

pages.title: Amnesia True Subway Horror
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Explore abandoned locations and try to escape the creatures in Amnesia True Subway Horror. Watch the shadows as you move through the different areas and look for a way out. There are three weapons available, including two for close combat and a firearm. Choose how to deal with each threat as you make your way through the dark.

pages.title: EG Happy Glass
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Draw a line to guide liquid into an empty glass in EG Happy Glass. Look at where the liquid starts and sketch a route that takes it into the container. Change the shape of the line if the flow goes somewhere else. Each level gives you another arrangement to solve, and you can try your own approach.

pages.title: Fishing
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Lower a hook to catch fish in Fishing. Watch the fish as they move past and choose when to send the hook down to meet one. Bring in as many fish as you can to build your score. Try to time the next drop for where a fish is headed instead of where it started.

pages.title: Winter Jigsaw
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Solve a series of winter pictures in Winter Jigsaw. Start with the first image and earn in-game money by putting its pieces together. Use those earnings to open more pictures from the ten available. Each picture has three difficulty modes, and the hardest one pays more when you finish it.

pages.title: Rugby Extreme
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Flick a rugby ball through the posts in Rugby Extreme. Aim past the flying, caped defenders who try to block the ball on its way to goal. Watch where a defender is headed before you take the shot so you can pick an opening. Keep scoring to see how many kicks you can send through.

pages.title: Farting Pig
pages.creator: Noobzilla
pages.description: Keep a sweet-potato-loving pig in the air in Farting Pig. The pig flies by farting, and you guide it so it stays away from places where it can drop into open space. Watch the direction it's moving in and adjust before it drifts too far. See how long you can keep it from falling.

pages.title: Lights Out
pages.creator: PlanB
pages.description: Turn off all the lights on a five-by-five board in Lights Out. Pressing a square toggles that light and the lights directly above, below, and beside it. Look at which lights a move will turn on as well as which ones it will switch off. Try to clear the board using as few moves as possible.

pages.title: Sand Worm!
pages.creator: UncertainStudio
pages.description: Take control of a sandworm and attack humans to score points in Sand Worm! Watch where people are and direct the worm toward them. Your score grows as you make successful attacks, so keep looking for the next target and see how many points you can build up in a run.

pages.title: 2 Avoiders
pages.creator: Arwin Margallo
pages.description: Drag the red block out of the way of falling black blocks in 2 Avoiders. Watch where the blocks are headed and move toward the next gap before they reach you. A clear space can close quickly when another block falls, so keep checking the whole play area as you try for a higher score.

pages.title: Smash My Car
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Take a hammer or a bomb to cars in Smash My Car. Pick a tool and use it to do damage, then try a different one to see how it affects the car. The game keeps a tally of the cars you've smashed, so you can check how much damage you've managed to rack up.

pages.title: Rats Cooking
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Help a chef deal with giant mutant rats in Rats Cooking. Use the mouse to go after the rats, take them down, and pick up coins as you play. The rats are a threat to the chef as well as the quarry, so keep an eye on them while you try to get enough for the grill.

pages.title: Tetris
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Fit falling shapes into complete rows in Tetris. Slide and rotate each piece before it lands so it can fill a gap in the stack. Finished rows clear and leave room for more shapes. Keep space near the top of the board and look for placements that leave you an opening for the next piece.

pages.title: Ice Queen Fashion Boutique
pages.creator: Play Belle Games
pages.description: Work as a fashion designer in Ice Queen Fashion Boutique. Browse the boutique and put together a look inspired by the Ice Queen's style. Choose pieces that work together, then try another combination if you want to change the look. The setting puts you in charge of the fashion choices.

pages.title: Jump Parking
pages.creator: Funmoth Games
pages.description: Launch a car into a parking space in Jump Parking. Choose a car, then use the direction and strength of each launch to get it across the course. Watch the fuel gauge if you need to make another push, and aim to collect stars along the way. Finish with the car in the marked parking area.
